Note:

[Story]
Xiao Zhang borrows a book from the library. He reads in the park until it gets dark. His sister sees it is dark and calls him to hurry home. Xiao Zhang rushes home in a hurry. His sister asks, "Do you return the library book?" Xiao Zhang says, "I return it."

[Question]
Why does Xiao Zhang say this?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Xiao Zhang thinks he already returns the book because he usually is punctual.
B. Xiao Zhang forgets that he does not return the book because he is too engrossed in reading.
C. Xiao Zhang deliberately lies because he does not want to get blamed.
D. Xiao Zhang deliberately lies because he wants to keep that book.
